name: Matlab docker test
summary: Test App that runs a Brainstorm MATLAB pipeline (import, resample, PSD, notch and band-pass filtering) on an MEG FIF file and exports an HTML report.
description: Registered as a MATLAB/Brainstorm container test. main calls a Brainstorm binary under /opt without a container, so it only works inside the author's BRAINOCKER image, and the README restricts reuse of the code.

outputs.description: Brainstorm HTML report of the processing steps.
